blocks.orig: Climbing Kilimanjaro via the 5-day Marangu Route with huts
blocks.html: Climb Kilimanjaro on the 5-day Marangu Route, staying in huts

blocks.orig: The Marangu route is a popular route and also the cheapest. It is the only route that offers mountain huts instead of tents for the overnight stays. The route leads straight up to the summit and down again via the same route. Altitude changes per day are significant, which is why this route is only suitable for experienced climbers.
blocks.html: Popular and also the least expensive, that is the Marangu route. On no other route do you sleep in mountain huts rather than tents. You climb directly up to the summit and come back down along the same path. Because the daily altitude changes are large, the route is only suitable for experienced climbers.

blocks.orig: The ascent via the Marangu route takes a total of five days. However, it is recommended to add an extra day to give your body time to adjust to the high altitude. If you choose to do so, you can stay an extra night in Horombo huts on the fourth day and make an acclimatization hike. This extra day significantly increases your chances of reaching the summit.
blocks.html: In total, the climb via the Marangu route lasts five days. We do advise adding one extra day, so your body has time to get used to the high altitude. If you take that option, you spend an additional night at Horombo huts on day four and go on an acclimatization hike. With this extra day your chances of reaching the summit go up considerably.

blocks.orig: Your Tanzania Trip offers a unique service throughout the climb
blocks.html: Your Tanzania Trip provides a special service from start to finish of the climb

blocks.orig: Climbing Kilimanjaro is the ultimate challenge! Little details can make a world of difference, which is why with us, you climb with professional guides, porters, and a cook. They take care of you during your ascent via the Marangu route, by checking your health twice a day and serving you delicious food. Sounds like a bit much? Not if you want to reach the top! Because we know that altitude sickness can creep up on you unnoticed and that proper nutrition* is essential to keep you going during a strenuous climb.
blocks.html: Climbing Kilimanjaro is the ultimate test! Small details can change everything, so with us you climb with professional guides, porters and a cook. They take good care of you on your ascent of the Marangu route, checking your health twice a day and cooking delicious meals for you. Does it sound like a lot? Not when the summit is your goal! We know that altitude sickness can come on unnoticed, and that the right nutrition* is crucial to keep your energy up during a demanding climb.

blocks.html: For advice on preparing to climb Kilimanjaro, you are always welcome to contact us, or have a look at our blog How can you prepare for climbing Kilimanjaro?

blocks.orig: When you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport our Your Tanzania Trip guide is there waiting for you. He then drops you off at your hotel, where you can relax from your flight.
blocks.html: Once you land at Kilimanjaro International Airport, our Your Tanzania Trip guide is there to meet you. He brings you to your hotel, where you can rest after your flight.

blocks.orig: Preparation for your climb: You meet your guide before the start of your climb, where he briefs you and offers advice on what to wear, what to pack, and other important tips to make your climb as comfortable as possible.
blocks.html: Getting ready for your climb: You meet your guide ahead of the climb for a briefing, including advice on what to wear, what to bring and other important tips to keep the climb as comfortable as possible.

blocks.orig: The first morning, your guide takes you from the hotel to Marangu Gate. The first part leads you through coffee and banana plantations and then you cross some untouched rainforest. After a seven-hour hike, you reach the Mandara huts. In the afternoon you have the option to go to the Maundi crater, a volcanic crater near the Mandara Huts or you can just rest and enjoy the beautiful surroundings. As this is your first day at this altitude, remember to drink plenty of water!
blocks.html: On the first morning your guide drives you from the hotel to Marangu Gate. You start out through banana and coffee plantations, then pass through a stretch of untouched rainforest. A seven-hour hike brings you to the Mandara huts. In the afternoon you can visit the Maundi crater, a volcanic crater close to the Mandara Huts, or simply rest and enjoy the lovely setting. It is your first day at this altitude, so be sure to drink lots of water!

blocks.orig: From Mandara Huts, the landscape slowly changes from cloud forests to grass plains with some heather and other vegetation. The higher you go, the less vegetation can be seen and the more it starts to look like a lunar landscape. The air is also becoming thinner now. A few hours after lunch you can make an acclimatization hike with an ascent of 200 meters and then return to Horombo Huts for dinner and overnight.
blocks.html: After Mandara Huts the scenery gradually shifts from cloud forest to grassy plains with heather and other plants. The higher you climb, the sparser the vegetation becomes, until it starts to resemble a moonscape. By now the air is getting thinner as well. A few hours after lunch you can go on an acclimatization hike, climbing 200 meters, before returning to Horombo Huts for dinner and the night.

blocks.orig: Today your hike leads through a kind of Alpine desert to a point between the two famous mountain peaks Kibo and Mawenzi. The hike is heavy and takes you through open landscapes with less shelter. You arrive at Kibo camp for lunch, after which you can relax in preparation for the big day ahead!
blocks.html: Today's hike crosses a sort of Alpine desert to a spot between Kibo and Mawenzi, the two well-known mountain peaks. It is a tough walk through open terrain with little shelter. You reach Kibo camp in time for lunch, and then you can rest ahead of the big day to come!

blocks.orig: In the middle of the night, you start your ascent to Uhuru Peak, with your flashlight. The biggest challenge lies in the first part of this climb until you reach Gilman's Point. From here, Uhuru Peak is not far and is relatively easy to reach. Once at the summit, enjoy a beautiful sunrise, which is quite impressive at this height! After celebrating this achievement at the top, your descent begins through the Kibo Huts Camp down to the Horombo huts for dinner and overnight. In total, you are on your feet for about twelve hours today, so prepare yourself for a hard but rewarding day!
blocks.html: In the middle of the night, flashlight in hand, you set out for Uhuru Peak. The hardest part is the first section of the climb, up to Gilman's Point. From there Uhuru Peak is close by and fairly easy to reach. On the summit, watch a beautiful sunrise, which is truly impressive from this height! Once you have celebrated your achievement at the top, you start the descent past Kibo Huts Camp and on to the Horombo huts for dinner and the night. Altogether you are walking for around twelve hours today, so be ready for a hard yet rewarding day!

blocks.orig: On this final day on the mountain, you descend to Marangu gate, the exit of Kilimanjaro National Park. This is a wonderful five to six-hour walk through the beautiful forests of Kilimanjaro. Your guide then takes you to your hotel, where you get a well-deserved rest.
blocks.html: On your last day on the mountain you walk down to Marangu gate, where you leave Kilimanjaro National Park. It is a lovely walk of five to six hours through Kilimanjaro's beautiful forests. Afterwards your guide takes you to your hotel for a well-earned rest.

blocks.orig: Sadly, this is the end of your holiday and the time to go home has arrived. Enjoy your last hours in Tanzania before our driver comes to pick you up and takes you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Still longing for more? It's also possible to add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
blocks.html: Unfortunately your holiday is coming to an end and it is time to go home. Enjoy your final hours in Tanzania until our driver picks you up and takes you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Still wanting more? You can also add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
